summary: Completed public API and browser regression testing for KhetSetu. Backend critical workflows passed 5/5; browser checks passed login/dashboard, produce search, marketplace confirmation, order advancement, prices, notifications, logout, admin metrics, guided-demo navigation, and mobile overflow. Guided demo Skip/Finish is not usable when unauthenticated because it routes to protected dashboard and immediately redirects to login.

critical.issue: Live response returns Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * while credentialed HttpOnly cookies are enabled. Credentialed CORS must use an explicit trusted origin; wildcard configuration is insecure and can cause browser credential failures.

integration_issues.flow: Guided demo Skip/Finish while logged out
integration_issues.issue: Demo controls navigate to /app/dashboard, but Protected redirects unauthenticated users to /login. A visitor cannot skip or finish the public guided demo into the promised destination.

The public nav link /marketplace renders the Public homepage component rather than a marketplace/search screen. The functional marketplace exists only under /app/marketplace after login, making the public Marketplace link misleading.

action_items: Replace credentialed wildcard CORS with explicit configured frontend origin(s) and verify OPTIONS responses.
Decide whether guided demo Skip/Finish should remain in a public demo route or authenticate before routing to protected dashboard.
Make public Marketplace navigation lead to a clear marketplace/login destination instead of rendering the homepage again.
critical_code_review_comments: CORS middleware uses allow_origin_regex='.*' with allow_credentials=True, defeating explicit-origin protection.
seed_demo exits whenever any user exists, so seeded demo accounts/admin credentials are not idempotently repaired after partial data or password changes.
Frontend Produce useEffect depends on a recreated load function and emits an exhaustive-deps warning; stabilize the callback or move request logic into the effect.
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted one uniquely prefixed browser/API produce listing; created one API order to verify persistence and status updates. Existing seeded demo data was otherwise preserved.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite is green for auth/session, farmer produce CRUD/search, marketplace/order/status, notifications/prices, and admin authorization. Browser coverage includes demo accounts, dashboards, core navigation, logout, admin metrics, guided demo controls, and mobile homepage. Retest CORS, public Marketplace destination, and unauthenticated demo Skip/Finish after fixes.
rca of the issue: Guided demo buttons call nav('/app/dashboard') unconditionally, while the /app/dashboard route is wrapped in Protected, which checks localStorage ks_user and redirects logged-out visitors to /login. Public Marketplace is similarly a route declaration issue: App maps /marketplace to <Public/> and only /app/marketplace to <Marketplace/>. CORS is a backend configuration issue: allow_origin_regex='.*' is always active even when CORS_ORIGINS is configured, and the live response confirms wildcard origin with credential cookies.
